profiles.name: software-dev
profiles.label: Software development
profiles.purpose: Build, change, review, and test software.
profiles.not_for: A security assessment whose deliverable is findings rather than code.
profiles.verification_focus: Build, type checks, lint, tests, security checks, and one real invocation.

profiles.name: devops-setup
profiles.label: DevOps and setup
profiles.purpose: Provision, configure, deploy, and operate systems.
profiles.verification_focus: Idempotence, syntax, dry runs, rollback, and a real deployment path.

profiles.name: marketing-outreach
profiles.label: Marketing and outreach
profiles.purpose: Create and operate campaigns and customer communication.
profiles.verification_focus: Audience fit, factual review, link checks, rendering, and send approval.

profiles.name: document-creation
profiles.label: Documents
profiles.not_for: Multi-source investigation where research is the main work.
profiles.verification_focus: Source accuracy, structure, rendered output, links, and final-file review.

profiles.name: data-crunching
profiles.label: Data and analysis
profiles.purpose: Clean, transform, join, analyze, and report data.
profiles.not_for: Narrative research without a data pipeline.
profiles.verification_focus: Input validation, reproducibility, totals, edge cases, and output inspection.

profiles.name: general-admin
profiles.label: General administration
profiles.purpose: Handle routine coordination and operational tasks.
profiles.not_for: Specialized work with a dedicated profile.
profiles.verification_focus: Completeness, faithful summaries, destination checks, and approval for external writes.

profiles.name: deep-research
profiles.label: Deep research
profiles.purpose: Investigate questions across multiple credible sources.
profiles.not_for: A document based only on material already supplied.
profiles.verification_focus: Source quality, claim coverage, citations, disagreement handling, and synthesis review.

profiles.name: creative-design
profiles.label: Creative design
profiles.not_for: A product interface, which belongs to software development.
profiles.verification_focus: Brief compliance, visual review, exports, accessibility, and brand consistency.

profiles.name: security-audit
profiles.label: Security audit
profiles.purpose: Assess security and deliver evidence-backed findings.
profiles.not_for: Ordinary feature work that includes a security check.
profiles.verification_focus: Reproduction, severity evidence, exploit boundaries, remediation, and retest.

profiles.name: autonomous-loops
profiles.label: Autonomous operation
profiles.purpose: Add controls for work that can run without immediate human review.
profiles.not_for: Use as the only work profile; combine it with the primary profile.
profiles.verification_focus: Budgets, checkpoints, stop conditions, recovery, and durable evidence.
